// Generated by explorer-proto/src/emit_journey.ts from the recorded exploration trace (discovered actions and
// locators) and sessions/auto-follow/charter.json (declared fixture, checkpoints and the teammate event). Do not
// edit by hand; re-run explore + emit --journey=auto-follow. The teammate's root and reply are posted over REST by
// Abe's own client, never through Abe's UI. This journey is not licence-gated, so pw.skipIfNoLicense() is not used.

import {expect, test} from '@mattermost/playwright-lib';

const ROOT = 'Pilot incident 42: database failover started';
const REPLY = 'Failover complete, replicas healthy';

/**
 * @objective I want to follow every new thread my teammates start in the Incidents channel without having to
 * follow each one by hand, so that new threads show up in my threads list and I can open one and read the
 * replies.
 *
 * The teammate stimulus (Abe's root and reply) is posted over REST by Abe's own client, not through his UI.
 * Hard expects only.
 */
test(
    'channel_auto_follow_new_threads: channels.notifications:auto-follow-new-threads',
    {tag: ['@channels', '@notifications', '@threads']},
    async ({pw}) => {
        const slug = pw.random.id();
        const password = pw.newTestPassword();
        const {adminClient, adminUser} = await pw.getAdminClient();
        if (!adminUser) {
            throw new Error('admin client is required');
        }

        // Server preconditions (read-only GET /config; never patched).
        const config = await adminClient.getConfig();
        expect(config.ServiceSettings.ThreadAutoFollow, 'precondition ServiceSettings.ThreadAutoFollow').toBe(true);
        expect(['always_on', 'default_on'], 'precondition ServiceSettings.CollapsedThreads').toContain(
            config.ServiceSettings.CollapsedThreads,
        );
        expect(config.TeamSettings.LockTeammateNameDisplay, 'precondition TeamSettings.LockTeammateNameDisplay').toBe(
            false,
        );

        const team = await adminClient.createTeam({name: `team-${slug}`, display_name: `Team ${slug}`, type: 'O'});
        const bea = await adminClient.createUser(
            {
                username: `bea${slug}`,
                email: `bea${slug}@sample.mattermost.com`,
                password,
                first_name: 'Bea',
                last_name: 'Okafor',
            } as never,
            '',
            '',
        );
        await adminClient.addToTeam(team.id, bea.id);
        const abe = await adminClient.createUser(
            {
                username: `abe${slug}`,
                email: `abe${slug}@sample.mattermost.com`,
                password,
                first_name: 'Abe',
                last_name: 'Lindqvist',
            } as never,
            '',
            '',
        );
        await adminClient.addToTeam(team.id, abe.id);
        const incidents = await adminClient.createChannel({
            team_id: team.id,
            name: `incidents-${slug}`,
            display_name: 'Incidents',
            type: 'O',
        });
        await adminClient.addToChannel(bea.id, incidents.id);
        await adminClient.addToChannel(abe.id, incidents.id);
        const lounge = await adminClient.createChannel({
            team_id: team.id,
            name: `lounge-${slug}`,
            display_name: 'Lounge',
            type: 'O',
        });
        await adminClient.addToChannel(bea.id, lounge.id);
        await adminClient.addToChannel(abe.id, lounge.id);

        const {client: beaClient} = await pw.makeClient({username: bea.username, password});
        const {client: abeClient} = await pw.makeClient({username: abe.username, password});

        await beaClient.savePreferences(bea.id, [
            {user_id: bea.id, category: 'display_settings', name: 'collapsed_reply_threads', value: 'on'},
            {user_id: bea.id, category: 'display_settings', name: 'name_format', value: 'full_name'},
            {user_id: bea.id, category: 'tutorial_step', name: bea.id, value: '999'},
            {user_id: bea.id, category: 'crt_thread_pane_step', name: bea.id, value: '999'},
            {user_id: bea.id, category: 'onboarding_task_list', name: 'onboarding_task_list_show', value: 'false'},
            {user_id: bea.id, category: 'onboarding_task_list', name: 'onboarding_task_list_open', value: 'false'},
        ]);

        await beaClient.viewMyChannel(lounge.id);
        await beaClient.viewMyChannel(incidents.id);

        // Read-backs: any mismatch is a setup failure, not a product finding.
        expect(
            (await adminClient.getChannelMember(incidents.id, bea.id)).notify_props?.channel_auto_follow_threads ??
                'off',
        ).not.toBe('on');
        expect(
            (await adminClient.getChannelMember(lounge.id, bea.id)).notify_props?.channel_auto_follow_threads ?? 'off',
        ).not.toBe('on');
        expect((await beaClient.getUserThreads(bea.id, team.id, {})).threads?.length ?? 0).toBe(0);

        // Sign the UI actor in through the framework and open the charter start path.
        const {page} = await pw.testBrowser.login({...bea, password});
        await page.goto(`/${team.name}/channels/town-square`);

        // Discovered UI actions up to the preference save (exact role + name from the recorded path).
        // discovered action (trace #1)
        await page.getByRole('link', {name: 'incidents public channel', exact: true}).click();
        // discovered action (trace #2)
        await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'incidents channel menu', exact: true}).click();
        // discovered action (trace #3)
        await page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Notification Preferences', exact: true}).click();
        // discovered action (trace #4)
        await page.getByRole('checkbox', {name: 'Automatically follow threads in this channel', exact: true}).click();
        // discovered action (trace #5)
        await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Save', exact: true}).click();

        // Checkpoint C1 (REST): Bea's per-channel thread auto-follow preference is on for incidents and not on for lounge.
        await expect
            .poll(() =>
                adminClient
                    .getChannelMember(incidents.id, bea.id)
                    .then((m) => m?.notify_props?.channel_auto_follow_threads),
            )
            .toBe('on'); // declared (charter C1)
        await expect
            .poll(() =>
                adminClient
                    .getChannelMember(lounge.id, bea.id)
                    .then((m) => m?.notify_props?.channel_auto_follow_threads ?? 'off'),
            )
            .not.toBe('on'); // declared (charter C1)

        // E1: teammate event posted over REST by abe's client (not through his UI).
        const root = await abeClient.createPost({channel_id: incidents.id, message: ROOT});
        const reply = await abeClient.createPost({channel_id: incidents.id, message: REPLY, root_id: root.id});

        // Checkpoint C2 (REST): Abe's root and reply exist in incidents, the reply is in the root's thread, and neither post mentions Bea.
        const fetched1 = await adminClient.getPost(root.id); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(fetched1.channel_id).toBe(incidents.id); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(fetched1.user_id).toBe(abe.id); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(fetched1.root_id).toBe(''); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(fetched1.message).toBe(ROOT); // declared (charter C2)
        const fetched2 = await adminClient.getPost(reply.id); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(fetched2.channel_id).toBe(incidents.id); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(fetched2.user_id).toBe(abe.id); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(fetched2.root_id).toBe(root.id); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(fetched2.message).toBe(REPLY); // declared (charter C2)
        const fetched3 = await adminClient.getPostThread(root.id); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(fetched3.order.length).toBe(2); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(ROOT.includes('@')).toBe(false); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(ROOT.includes(bea.username)).toBe(false); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(ROOT.includes('Bea')).toBe(false); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(REPLY.includes('@')).toBe(false); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(REPLY.includes(bea.username)).toBe(false); // declared (charter C2)
        expect(REPLY.includes('Bea')).toBe(false); // declared (charter C2)

        // Discovered UI actions after the event, with the UI checkpoints at the states they reach.
        // discovered action (trace #6)
        await page.getByRole('link', {name: 'Threads', exact: true}).click();
        // Checkpoint C3 (UI): Bea's followed-thread list shows the thread Abe started, with its root text.
        await expect(page).toHaveURL((u) => new RegExp(`^/${team.name}/threads(/[A-Za-z0-9]+)?$`).test(u.pathname)); // declared (charter C3)
        await expect(page.getByRole('tab', {name: 'Followed threads', exact: true})).toHaveAttribute(
            'aria-selected',
            'true',
        ); // declared (charter C3)
        await expect(page.getByRole('tab', {name: 'Followed threads', exact: true})).toHaveCount(1); // declared (charter C3)
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('tabpanel').getByRole('link', {name: 'Thread by Abe Lindqvist', exact: true}),
        ).toHaveCount(1); // declared (charter C3)
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('tabpanel').getByRole('link', {name: 'Thread by Abe Lindqvist', exact: true}),
        ).toContainText(ROOT); // declared (charter C3)
        await expect(page.getByText('No followed threads yet', {exact: true})).toHaveCount(0); // declared (charter C3)
        // discovered action (trace #7)
        await page.getByRole('link', {name: '1 thread', exact: true}).click();
        // Checkpoint C4 (UI): With that thread opened in the followed-thread view, Bea sees the reply.
        await expect(page).toHaveURL((u) => u.pathname === `/${team.name}/threads/${root.id}`); // declared (charter C4)
        await expect(page.getByRole('heading', {name: /Thread/, level: 3})).toHaveCount(1); // declared (charter C4)
        await expect(page.getByText(REPLY).first()).toBeVisible(); // declared (charter C4)
        await expect(page.getByText(ROOT).first()).toBeVisible(); // declared (charter C4)

        // Checkpoint FINAL (REST, independent of the UI): Independently of the UI, Bea's followed-thread list for the team contains Abe's root.
        const list = await beaClient.getUserThreads(bea.id, team.id, {}); // declared (charter FINAL)
        expect(list.threads.map((t) => t.id)).toContain(root.id); // declared (charter FINAL)
        const matched = list.threads.find((t) => t.id === root.id); // declared (charter FINAL)
        expect(matched).toBeTruthy(); // declared (charter FINAL)
        expect(matched?.post.channel_id).toBe(incidents.id); // declared (charter FINAL)
        expect(matched?.reply_count).toBe(1); // declared (charter FINAL)
    },
);
